title: Rotate Function
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n, calculate the rotation function F(k) for each possible rotation k.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n, calculate the rotation function F(k) for each possible rotation k. Define F(k) as the sum of i * arrk[i] for all i from 0 to n-1. Return the maximum value of F(k) for any k.
constraints: For each right rotation k, score sum(i * rotated[i]); return the maximum.
hints: Adjacent rotation scores differ by the array total and one wrapped value.
Compute F(0) and the total sum once.
For right rotation k, F(k)=F(k-1)+total-n*nums[n-k]; retain the maximum.
All nonwrapped values gain one index while the wrapped value loses n-1, yielding the recurrence.
editorial: All nonwrapped values gain one index while the wrapped value loses n-1, yielding the recurrence.
